Caption_Text: A mounted album page contains a horizontal photograph of a crowded riverfront. Numerous low boats fill the foreground, while taller junks with upright masts and sails occupy the middle ground. Buildings form a thin horizon line, and a handwritten caption appears beneath the pasted photograph.

Three long, narrow boats cross a turbulent sea beneath a large curling wave. Many small figures bend forward inside the boats, while Mount Fuji appears as a low triangular form in the distance. Deep blue and pale blue water contrasts with cream paper and tan boat hulls. Vertical Japanese text appears in the upper left.

A full-length studio portrait shows one adult man standing against a plain dark backdrop. He wears a light robe secured with a dark sash and holds a sheathed sword horizontally at waist height. A folded fan is visible near his lower body, and the figure turns slightly while looking toward the camera.

A pale and substantially faded photograph shows a palace complex beside a reflecting pool. An open arched pavilion stands at the left, while a tall narrow tower and a domed structure rise toward the right. Low contrast makes smaller architectural and landscape details difficult to distinguish.

A vertical architectural photograph focuses on a large carved stone pillar at the left edge of a recessed portico. Circular and figural reliefs run down its surface. Additional columns, brackets and dark openings recede to the right, while a rough stone floor occupies the foreground.

A sepia-toned landscape photograph presents a high waterfall descending between steep granite cliffs. A calm river occupies the foreground, bordered by dark trees that frame the brighter rock face and falling water. The photographic image has rounded upper corners and is mounted on a larger cream-colored support.

A pyramid rises near the centre-right of a broad desert view. Low stone structures extend across the left and lower middle ground, while a pale sandy foreground leads toward the monument. The nearly blank sky and restrained tonal range give the architecture a stark geometric presence.

A rectangular stone building stands amid dense vegetation. Three dark doorways open across the lower facade, while a decorated horizontal band and low upper structure rise above. Trees partly obscure the building, and two small standing figures provide scale.

A richly dressed seated woman appears within a rectangular painting surrounded by coloured and gold borders. She sits cross-legged on a patterned surface with fruit near one hand. Behind her, a tree, river, vegetation, mountains and large clouds form an expansive landscape.

A vertical studio photograph shows two barefoot adult men standing against a plain backdrop. Each holds a tall bundle of narrow bamboo tubes upright. The taller figure at left wears a broad hat and wrapped lower garment; the shorter figure wears a head covering, light top and patterned lower cloth.

A mounted head-and-shoulders portrait shows one young woman facing forward. A light cloth covers the top and sides of her head, while long wavy hair falls over both shoulders. The pale print is surrounded by a mount marked with stains, scratches and uneven discolouration.

A seated adult woman faces the camera beside a large woven basket. She wears a light head covering and blouse with a strongly striped skirt. Her hands rest on or near the basket, and bright illumination separates her figure from a dark background.

A frontal museum photograph shows a cast-metal head with a rounded face, almond-shaped eyes, broad nose and closed lips. A densely patterned cap covers the crown, with long beaded strands descending beside both ears. A layered collar forms a wide base against a neutral grey background.

An official museum photograph shows a large woven cloth wrapped around a grey mannequin. The textile is assembled from narrow strips with repeated rectangular and striped patterns in green, red, yellow, blue and muted brown. A brighter patterned band runs vertically along the mannequin's right side.
